events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked at your trip and found two parts of the route where the driver went off course and nothing in the trip chat explains why. You didn't agree to any different route beforehand, and a driver's own note that his GPS rerouted him doesn't count as your agreement. So we're refunding $3.74, paid as a Ryde voucher on your account. No further action is needed from you. Thanks for flagging it — this helps us keep routes accurate.

DRIVER: We reviewed the trip and found two segments where the route went off course. The trip chat shows no agreed alternative route with the rider beforehand, and a GPS reroute in your post-trip note doesn't count as rider agreement. We're issuing the rider a $3.74 Ryde voucher for those segments. No flag has been placed on your account, so you can keep driving as usual. Just a reminder to confirm any route change with the rider in the chat before taking it.
